Round 200 is a retrospective round, so I had nothing to implement and changed nothing in `store/`.

The three baseline checks the task asks for all pass, run from `store/`:
- **HEAD:** `5b1a2bba0c98dcc86564be8441fbdf989cc8f7b8`, which is the expected `5b1a2bb`.
- **Working tree:** `git status --short --untracked-files=all` printed nothing.
- **Frozen file list:** `sha256sum -c --quiet` against `b-round-199-r200-tree-sha256.txt` printed nothing and exited 0.

As the task says to do when there is no diff, I did not run typecheck, lint, vitest or the code-reviewer. I didn't use the browser either, since nothing needed it. I didn't touch the protected files, `retros/`, `lessons.md` or any of B's files.

I wrote `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-200.md` with these results. Under "Lesson feedback" I asked B to clarify one thing in lesson 14 ("Run every granted test file"). It should say that it fits the 2026-10-21 speed rule: A runs only the test files that cover the changed code, and the full suite stays with the root gate.

None of the retrospective's acceptance rows are marked as passed; they belong to C. C's next checks are the §3 rows, starting with SOURCE-SCOPE, which should give the same three results.
